lines.text: Many learners say: I lost my handphone.
Phone! I lost my phone at the park.

quiz.stem: I lost my ___ at the park.

native.tip: Di Indonesia kita sering bilang “handphone” atau “HP”. Orang yang berbahasa Inggris hanya bilang phone atau cell phone.
native.caption: Pernah bilang begini? “I lost my handphone.” 😅 Bilang phone saja: “I lost my phone.” Dengarkan Kak Carlos, lalu ulangi! Latihan lagi di app Lexkite.
native.comment: Jawaban: “phone”. Ucapkan dengan lantang: “I lost my phone.” lalu tulis satu kalimat tentang ponselmu. Latihan gratis lainnya di sini: {link}

en.tip: In Indonesia we often say “handphone” or “HP”. English speakers just say phone or cell phone.
en.caption: Ever say this? “I lost my handphone.” 😅 Just say phone: “I lost my phone.” Listen to Carlos and repeat! Practice more in the Lexkite app.
